entries.mem0ai/mem0: This official Hermes Agent memory provider offers a universal layer for managing multi-level User, Session, and Agent states. It supports temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval through an OSS SDK, self-hosted server, or managed cloud environment.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: OpenViking is an official context database that organizes information as a virtual filesystem using viking:// URIs. It utilizes a three-tier loading system to achieve a 91% token reduction and provides observable retrieval trajectories for debugging context paths.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: This platform enables persistent long-term memory through a self-hosted knowledge graph engine that supports unified ingestion and multimodal data. It provides Python, Rust, and TypeScript clients alongside a local UI for managing cross-session agent memory.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: This opinionated agent brain generates cited prose answers and performs explicit gap analysis to identify missing information. It builds knowledge graphs using typed edges without LLM calls and ensures data isolation for scoped institutional memory.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: An official memory provider featuring sub-300ms recall and byte-level deduplication for efficient prompt caching. It automates fact extraction and user profiling while integrating data from Google Drive, Gmail, Notion, and GitHub.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: Hindsight provides long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows that allow agent memory to learn over time. It supports over 25 LLM providers and offers flexible deployment options including Docker, Kubernetes, and managed cloud.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: This library serves as the core FastAPI-based logic for building stateful agents and acts as the upstream foundation for the honcho-self-hosted Hermes wrapper. It includes Python and TypeScript SDKs specifically designed for session and peer management.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: This official provider manages context trees using git-like version control, including commit, branch, and merge operations. It features a 5-tier retrieval system where four tiers are non-LLM based, enabling sub-100ms response times via a TUI or REPL interface.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: A zero-dependency memory system for Hermes Agents that achieves sub-millisecond performance using a single SQLite database for local storage. It integrates via MCP, Python SDK, or OpenWebUI and requires only Python 3.10 and one pure-Python dependency.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: This seven-layer system utilizes Qdrant, Redis, and SQLite to manage persistent memory, structured facts, and an auto-curated wiki. It employs a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize specific injected context during task execution.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: This recursive harness produces filesystem-first artifacts like playbooks and context bundles to help agents succeed on complex tasks. It features outcome-gated promotion and ablation-backed attribution to validate the effectiveness of context changes.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: A Lossless Context Management plugin that uses a hierarchical DAG and SQLite store to ensure no messages are lost. It provides specialized recall tools, such as lcm_grep and lcm_recall, to help Hermes Agents recover specific details from history.
entries.vshulcz/deja-vu: This project indexes existing local session history from 22 supported coding agents to enable millisecond lookups over months of past data. It prioritizes safety by redacting keys and tokens during the indexing process.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: This self-hosted backend provides private cross-session memory for Hermes Agent using Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis. It supports any OpenAI-compatible LLM provider or local inference servers for persistent storage.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: Signetai maintains a living semantic ontology through a background dreaming process to provide a portable identity and memory layer. It supports real-time ingestion from GitHub, Discord, and Obsidian for use across multiple agent harnesses.
entries.plur-ai/plur: This shared memory layer stores data as human-readable YAML files on local disk using an open engram format. It utilizes a hybrid search combining BM25 and local embeddings to retrieve information for MCP-integrated tools.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: ClawMem is an on-device context engine that operates locally without API keys or cloud dependencies. It employs hybrid retrieval, including vector search and BM25, to provide memory via MCP and agent hooks.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This tool optimizes context through block reordering and deduplication to enable prefix reuse and reduce prefill latency by 1.5–3×. It offers native plugin support for the Hermes Agent ecosystem to save up to 36% in token usage.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: Sibyl-Memory is a file-based long-term memory system that uses SQLite with FTS5 search instead of vector databases or embeddings. It is delivered as a five-package plugin family, including a dedicated Hermes adapter.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This self-maintaining plugin provides explainable recall by attaching a why_retrieved tag to every result. It features a self-directing loop to resolve knowledge gaps and supports owner-scoping for multi-user environments.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: Agentcairn uses an Obsidian vault as the source of truth, storing memory as inspectable Markdown files. It runs locally without a daemon or telemetry, utilizing DuckDB as a replaceable retrieval cache.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: This memory kernel stack integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace to manage state via SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma. It is designed to provide agents with a purpose-built evidence packet for every query.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: Flowstate-qmd is an anticipatory memory system that prefetches context by monitoring agent session logs. It uses SQLite-vec and GGUF models for local-first storage and provides an MCP-native server for automated configuration.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: Perseus resolves live workspace state into verified facts before the context window opens to reduce prompt tokens by up to 94%. It features a local-first architecture using SQLite and FTS5 with native Model Context Protocol support.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: This provider enables reflective memory through semantic search using BM25 full-text and ranked graph traversal. It automates indexing for codebases and multimedia via OCR, utilizing edge tags to create navigable, bidirectional relationships between stored notes.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: This tool reduces prompt token overhead for Hermes Agent v0.14.0 by utilizing local BM25 tool ranking to select relevant schemas. It includes a dashboard for tracking estimated token savings and supports native tool search functionality.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: A local-only plugin that stores data in a single .lbdb embedded graph database file and uses 1-10 importance ranking to surface high-priority memories. It features BM25-first retrieval, named graph relationships, and optional GLiNER2 entity extraction.
entries.conorbronsdon/claude-context-os: This Git-backed layer manages context and workflows for coding agents like Claude Code and Codex by storing identity and decisions in plain Markdown files. It facilitates a source-neutral migration workflow for documents and chat histories across supported agents.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This episodic memory plugin features a pull-model with an on-demand summarizer and supports real, immediate event deletion to prevent persistent summaries from affecting future recall. It provides a trace.jsonl audit log for monitoring all memory and prefetch operations.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server allows Hermes agents to handle payments using USDC and stablecoins across 29 chains, including EVM and Solana. It enables agents to charge for APIs or pay for services with 0% transaction fees settled directly to wallets.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin indexes local skills, scripts, and MCP server configurations to improve agent routing and capability discovery. It provides tools for artifact search and graph neighbor traversal while using feedback to refine local routing hints.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: XMemo provides durable cross-session memory for Hermes Agent through pre-turn context injection and session-end snapshots. It ensures reliability using a local SQLite layer and a write outbox for searching and updating agent state.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: This plugin integrates Exabase M-1 to provide self-organizing long-term memory for agents. It supports configurable query expansion and result reranking to optimize the retrieval of manually stored or searched memories.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: An AI-native memory provider that offers AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and multiple retrieval methods including HNSW ANN, sparse, and FM-index search. It supports metadata filtering and MinHash deduplication, operating via native Rust FFI or an HTTP daemon.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin provides private local code memory for repositories, enabling semantic search and grounded Q&A through a local SourceVault server. It adds deterministic slash commands and LLM-callable tools for file reads and indexing synchronization.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider features 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal using a hybrid search of BM25, vector, and graph methods. It also performs automatic context checkpointing during message compression to maintain agent state.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: This toolkit provides a file-based curation loop that identifies data rot and contradictions within agent memory using specialized 'rot' and 'lint' curators. It utilizes a git-backed directory for versioned markdown storage and offers five slash commands to manage the capture, recall, and review of evidence-cited diffs.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework implements a subagent-driven development process for autonomous task execution while enforcing test-driven development and YAGNI principles. It functions as a plugin for various coding harnesses and CLIs to support a structured software development methodology.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first design and prototyping system for macOS and Windows that generates documents and decks using real CSS and components. It features a coding-agent CLI that integrates with Hermes Agent, Claude Code, and OpenAI-compatible endpoints.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This library provides 818 structured skills across 34 security domains, mapped to frameworks including MITRE ATT&CK, ATLAS, and NIST AI RMF. The skills are compatible with over 26 AI platforms to support standardized cybersecurity operations.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This skill converts natural language, SQL, and IaC into .drawio diagrams while preserving manual layout adjustments during updates. It enforces architecture contracts through Diagram-as-Test and YAML/JSON rules.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Serving as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, this tool provides a master router and connector skills for payments, escrow, and dispute resolution. It utilizes ERC-7710 delegated permissions and x402 payments to facilitate secure autonomous transactions.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This tool audits and rewrites content to eliminate detectable AI patterns using 72 structural and linguistic categories. It supports rewrite and detect-only modes and is compatible with agents such as Hermes, Claude Code, and OpenClaw.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This project unifies isolated skill silos into a shared, evolving library that natively integrates with Hermes, QwenPaw, and OpenClaw. It includes a bilingual dashboard for the inspection of skills and session traces to facilitate collective skill evolution.
entries.wondelai/skills: A cross-platform library containing 51 expert frameworks and 14 guided metaskills compatible with agent-plugins.org specifications. It maintains session state within the project's documentation directory for use with Claude Code and Codex.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection features 1,169 professional and life skills distributed as plain markdown files under the MIT license. The skills are designed to run natively in Hermes Agent and Claude Code with ready-to-paste exports for other assistants.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This tool enables Hermes Agent and other platforms to perform video searches and extract transcripts, channel data, and playlists. It requires a TranscriptAPI key and is compatible with OpenClaw, Cursor, and Windsurf.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: A meta-skill plugin that monitors active workflows to automatically detect and propose reusable skills. It generates both Python plugin scaffolds and SKILL.md documentation, managed via specialized slash commands.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project provides skills that enable Hermes Agent to generate its own custom thinking instructions and analytical prompts for specific tasks. It includes pre-built analytical lenses and generates reports that identify potential analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This project provides type-safe support for agentskills.io using Pydantic AI to manage modular packages of instructions and resources. It implements progressive disclosure to maintain prompt efficiency and supports both programmatic skills and remote registries.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This skill set transforms rough concepts into structured design documents and implementation handoffs for Hermes Agent. It features Lite and Full modes for varying project complexities and includes a spec review gate utilizing PASS/FAIL evaluation models.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This literate programming skill enables agents to weave prose, diagrams, and source code into .lit.md files. It includes a tangler for extracting runnable source files and automatically synchronizes edits from source files back into the primary literate document.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Operating via a mechanism kernel and Markdown-based recipes, this harness manages long-running agents through structured memory and immutable decision records. It implements the SLP cooperative-agent protocol to facilitate supervised team generations and cross-role handbacks.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin enables cross-instance shared memory via markdown files to capture high-value decisions and outcomes. It provides a pipeline for fine-tuning and transitioning to replacement models, allowing agents to effectively train their own successors.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: Following the Agent Skills specification, this project provides specialized skills for interacting with Oracle networks and smart contracts. It supports integrations for CCIP, VRF, and Data Feeds, alongside specialized services for CRE and ACE.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This community-driven repository offers Hermes Agent skills, installation guides, and integrations specifically tailored for Portuguese speakers. All skills are provided in the SKILL.md format and adhere to the agentskills.io standard.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: These official skills provide specialized prompting guidelines and API integration for FLUX image and video generation. The project includes a router for managing multi-step video workflows and supports both Python and TypeScript clients.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool converts repositories, documentation, and developer discourse into version-pinned, agentskills.io-compliant instruction files. It features lifecycle tooling for creating and testing skills, with the ability to link instructions directly to specific source lines.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: This registry facilitates the discovery and installation of reusable AI skills with recursive dependency resolution. It includes a Python client and CLI, while supporting commerce features through TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: Designed for complex multi-step tasks, this skill provides autonomous execution with real-time progress tracking and decision logging. It ensures operational safety through built-in checkpoints and rollback procedures for recovery.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: This local-first workflow language uses a single Rust binary to execute 'Intent as Code' across any model. It audits workflows for costs and permissions before execution and generates verifiable, hash-chained receipts for every run.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes Agent to manage files, calendars, tasks, and contacts through standard WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It ensures secure communication via HTTPS and includes a guided script for credential validation and configuration.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This progressive MCP client utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage during agent interactions. It features a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and incrementally discovers server metadata and tool schemas.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: Serving as a community hub for skill discovery, this project implements the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification for one-click installations. It operates autonomously on NVIDIA infrastructure and provides federated search across GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: This retrieval skill uses a five-layer system, including hard triggers and semantic embeddings, to narrow skill lists before LLM calls. It optimizes performance by reducing token usage and offers graceful degradation if specific embedding models are unavailable.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: Designed as an ADHD-friendly execution system, this project facilitates agent-driven scheduling and habit tracking via MCP connections. It stores data locally in a single SQLite file and provides interfaces through React and Expo-based applications.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This read-only skill performs adversarial code reviews by deploying three parallel subagents to identify edge cases and integration issues. It combines deterministic pre-scans using tools like Semgrep and Bandit with verified findings from a hardened sandbox.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin optimizes and scores prompts across various interfaces, including CLI, Discord, and Telegram, to reduce token usage by up to 80%. It supports 97 languages and evaluates prompt quality across five distinct dimensions.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: Inspired by Claude Code, this skill uses parallel agents focused on hygiene, clarity, and correctness to simplify code across multiple programming languages. It employs a tiered application process that includes a mandatory approval gate for changes.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project implements systematic investigation protocols and multi-story task decomposition with mandatory evidence-based verification gates. It includes a Python goal engine to manage persistent task states and prevent early-stop errors during debugging.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This C# and .NET implementation of the agentskills.io pattern enables tool-based skill loading through Microsoft.Extensions.AI. It supports progressive disclosure via SKILL.md files and automates the registration of common agent skill directories.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This comprehensive cybersecurity lab provides Hermes Agent with over 2,000 skills and 131 tools for network forensics and exploitation. it integrates 28 frameworks, including MITRE ATT&CK and NIST, to handle CVE-driven tasks and real exploits.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: This toolkit adds session management and worktree recovery to agent workflows, providing memory between conversations and detecting state drift. It also orchestrates parallel subagents for architectural reviews and provides scaffolding for new skill development.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This skill automates the creation of reproducible demo GIFs for repository READMEs using vhs or Playwright. It optimizes files to remain under 8 MB and embeds the rendered output directly into the project documentation.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: This tool generates Claude Code and portable agent skills from plain language while preventing technical debt through frontmatter validation. It monitors official specifications weekly to detect drift and uses CI-friendly exit codes to report profile mismatches.
entries.Carlo1911/skill-evolution: This host-agnostic framework establishes a self-improvement loop by analyzing session history to propose and gate skill updates behind LLM-judge and regression evaluators. It operates locally using the Python standard library, requiring no external services or daemons.
entries.Diabloluo/hermes-hud: This local-first observability dashboard provides 11 monitoring tabs for tracking token costs, errors, and session health in real-time. It enforces a strict read-only boundary with zero outbound telemetry and supports optional incident alerts via Telegram and Feishu.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This CLI and MCP server enables agents to search a database of over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 skills. It provides direct installation commands for discovered tools and integrates with compatible clients like Hermes, Cursor, and Claude Code.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: This project provides deterministic path routing and Python interpreter selection across Windows, Git Bash, and WSL environments. It ensures file operations use environment-specific syntax and verifies existing project-compatible runtimes without requiring new installations.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates USDC payments for HTTP 402 responses using protocols such as Pay Link, x402, and MPP. It is designed for compatibility with the agentskills.io standard and works across OpenClaw and Hermes Agent.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: This utility certifies the quality of AI agent skills by testing structure, functionality, and security within isolated Docker containers. It produces cryptographically verifiable certificates using Ed25519 signatures and provides a public API for verification.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This plugin allows users to earn USDC on the Base network by answering support bounties without requiring accounts or API keys. It includes tools for creating bounty boards and buying context, with payments settled automatically upon human approval.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: This MCP server exposes 191 tools and five production-grade skills for accessing structured web data across 31 platforms. It supports multiple AI environments including Hermes, Claude, Cursor, and OpenHands.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This skill generates multi-scale Chinese news reports ranging from global to street-level geographic scales. It utilizes semantic memory to integrate user interests and produces structured briefings containing core conclusions and action suggestions.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This collection provides local processing for transcribing Douyin videos to Markdown and macOS-based OCR for extracting data from invoices. It also includes a writing engine designed to adjust the tone and style of AI-generated text.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides daily-updated Nix packages for AI coding agents, including Hermes and various development tools. It supports both open-source and unfree licensed software binaries for use within the Nix ecosystem.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: ClawPhone offers an automated installer and configuration guides for running Hermes Agent and Antigravity CLI on ARM64 Android devices via Termux. It enables hardware and UI access by leveraging Termux:API and Termux:GUI integrations.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This repository features a one-line installation script for deploying Hermes Agent in Termux environments on Android. The setup supports over 70 tools, persistent memory, and connectivity to both external providers and local models via Ollama.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community Helm chart facilitates Kubernetes deployments with a focus on single-writer state safety for persistent storage. It supports direct deployments or operator-ready workflows and includes a configurable gateway mode with API and webhook listeners.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: This one-command installer brings Hermes to both Android and iOS using Termux and iSH, respectively. It integrates with Telegram for voice and file messaging and allows for scheduled tasks via cron jobs on Android.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: Hermesclaw provides a sandboxed environment for Hermes Agent using NVIDIA OpenShell for hardware-enforced security. It implements kernel-level restrictions on network and filesystem access alongside configurable policies for messaging and web searches.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane for operating Hermes agents on Docker or Kubernetes, offering monitoring features like per-agent metrics and LLM budget caps. It provides multiple interface options including a REST API, CLI, and MCP server.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project provides a Docker sandbox image that bundles the official Hermes installation with mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted home directories and allows users to build specific Hermes tags using build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This NixOS module enables reproducible Hermes deployments through declarative configuration of workspace documents and CLI settings. It features hybrid skill management and integrates secure secrets handling via systemd EnvironmentFiles or sops-nix.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ is a Docker-based control plane designed to manage multiple agent instances with separate workspaces and RBAC-controlled access. It supports hierarchy-aware inter-agent delegation and enterprise MCP access for external AI client integration.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: This production-oriented deployment configures Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service for headless operation on Ubuntu and Debian. It is designed to enable the autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs and integrates with Nous Portal.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: Hermes OTG is a portable distribution that runs from external drives without requiring host installation or registry modifications. It bundles Python, PortableGit, and rescue tools to support Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes in isolated offline environments.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework deploys specialized agents for fundamental, sentiment, and technical financial analysis. It utilizes a researcher team to conduct bullish and bearish debates, overseen by risk management and portfolio manager agents for final approvals.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This self-hosted orchestration platform governs agent registration, memory browsing, and cost tracking across Web UI, CLI, and REST API interfaces. It supports multi-agent workflows and can be installed locally via Node.js or deployed using Docker.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This control surface manages multiple coding agents, including Hermes Agent, through TUI and web dashboards. It ensures persistent sessions via tmux integration and provides sandboxing through Docker, Podman, and Apple Containers.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This execution engine manages Hermes agents and specialist teams using the Claude-style MCP protocol in stdio mode. It is the first MCP engine on the Solana blockchain and features HTTP signal detection to handle payment-required states for APIs.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: This template uses a level-based architecture and task bus pattern to scale Hermes Agent from single VPS instances to automated teams. It includes bundled skills for specialized operations such as security auditing, backup management, and VPS provisioning.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This framework builds autonomous agent swarms with durable memory and MCP tool integration across more than 23 LLM providers. It features visual org charts to help users manage agent team delegation and orchestration.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control interface allows users to supervise autonomous Hermes Agent work through a centralized Kanban board and review queue. It provides live streaming of agent reasoning and requires human-in-the-loop verification for all proposed task completions.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This project coordinates 17 specialized AI agents focused on research, planning, implementation, quality, and infrastructure. It utilizes a strict pipeline architecture managed by a Master Orchestrator for precise routing and coordination.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This local collaboration system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents using MCP and ACP protocols for tool and communication handling. It features a real-time Web UI for monitoring agent dialogues and task flows via Hermes Kanban.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark code for Hermes Agent. It orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations while providing structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This agent-vs-agent arena orchestrates nine autonomous agents across two competing AI companies. It uses Paperclip and Hermes Agent for task execution and learning, visualized through a real-time dashboard and scoreboard.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: This fully-local framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack optimized for consumer GPUs like the RTX 4080/5080. It uses Hermes for task routing and tool-calling while performing parallel model querying and synthesis via Ollama.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool maintains a local, pre-indexed knowledge graph of codebases to minimize token consumption and tool calls for coding agents. It features automatic synchronization upon file changes and provides structural extraction for languages including TypeScript, JavaScript, ArkTS, and Python.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: Tokscale is a CLI utility designed to monitor token usage across various AI coding agents and IDEs. It offers a 3D visualization dashboard and allows users to submit their usage data to a public leaderboard and profile.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer enables developers to inspect API traffic from multiple coding agents while automatically redacting authentication headers. It generates self-contained HTML viewers for exported sessions, facilitating the analysis of agent communication.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget provides real-time tracking of tokens, costs, and rate limits for over 35 AI coding tools. It supports multi-device synchronization and offers historical breakdowns categorized by tool, model, and specific project.
entries.bergside/typeui: TypeUI offers design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers to assist in building user interfaces with AI. It is compatible with any provider supporting markdown and integrates directly with agents like Hermes, Cursor, and Claude.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This project provides an opinionated workflow layer that coordinates seven specialized agents to build and operate applications. It loads 36 skills and 6 workflows, supporting autonomous execution on both laptops and virtual private servers.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: Hermes-skins allows users to customize the terminal UI of Hermes Agent with YAML-based themes and ASCII art. It includes diverse aesthetic options such as retro DOS and cyberpunk styles, modifying elements like banner colors and spinners.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This project ports the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to the Claude Code Channel, allowing them to run natively without external processes or OAuth. It also includes specialized MLOps tools for vLLM, GGUF inference, and reinforcement learning training.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This platform establishes a social economy for autonomous agents by providing encrypted agent-to-agent messaging via the Signal Protocol. It facilitates agent commerce through Solana-based payments and supports identity registration using human-readable handles.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: Vessel is an AI-native browser built for autonomous agent control via MCP, featuring a supervisor sidebar for managing workflows. It supports multiple AI providers and includes an undo functionality to revert recent changes made by an agent.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This project provides memory capabilities for various frameworks and includes chat bots for platforms like Telegram and Slack. It features a plugin for Claude Code that enables automatic context recall during agent sessions.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings during agent workflows. It comes with over 40 pre-configured skills for finance and DevOps, supported by an automated cross-platform installer.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: This framework enables the creation of scoped Hermes Agents through per-folder configurations and local skills. It allows users to seamlessly switch between default and scoped agents while maintaining project-local memories, tools, and custom instructions.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool provides automated installation for the hermes-agent stack and 12+ supporting services across three scalable deployment tiers. It facilitates rapid setup with support for 29 community plugins across six functional categories at zero cost.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: A static linter that analyzes AI agent configurations, tool descriptions, and system prompts for ambiguity and overlapping definitions. It operates locally without LLM or API calls to detect issues like missing termination conditions and unbounded retries.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration utility transitions OpenClaw assets, including SOUL.md and memory archives, into Hermes-compatible YAML and JSON formats. It automates the setup of systemd gateway services and maps nested authentication structures for the new environment.
entries.observeco/observeco: This self-healing observability tool uses a native Hermes plugin to export real-time telemetry from agent conversations without cloud dependencies. It features passive analysis and active probing to detect performance drift relative to local file changes.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: This local-first skill uses dynamic slash commands and a deterministic runtime to help users generate revenue via Hermes Agent. It prioritizes security by requiring explicit approval for any external actions or write operations.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: This voice-enabled assistant adds offline, open-mic capabilities to Hermes Agent with support for 35 languages and wake-word activation. It functions without API keys or accounts, featuring adaptive turn-taking and barge-in functionality.
entries.181079342/hermes-memoss: This memory plugin for Hermes supports semantic search and multi-dimensional storage for agent data. It includes dedicated tools for managing memories and a circuit breaker to handle MemOS API outages.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: This cross-platform manager, built with Tauri 2, provides a unified desktop interface for controlling Hermes Agent alongside other tools like Claude Code and Gemini CLI. It is compatible with Windows, macOS, and Linux, serving as an all-in-one desktop controller for multiple agent engines.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi is a local cowork application that integrates dozens of external agents, including Hermes Agent, into a single interface. It features 21 built-in professional assistants and offers remote access through a WebUI and various messaging platforms.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: Developed with Python and vanilla JavaScript, this project provides a web and mobile-friendly interface for interacting with Hermes Agent. It includes a circular context ring for monitoring token usage and supports secure remote access via SSH tunnels.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: This desktop companion app simplifies the Hermes Agent experience through guided installation and provider setup. It offers a dedicated GUI for managing chat sessions, tools, and multiple AI providers in one location.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio: This web dashboard enables unified configuration for Hermes Agent across 10 messaging platforms, including Telegram and Discord. It features a visual workflow canvas with approval gates, local SQLite session storage, and detailed usage analytics for token consumption.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace features a Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers for complex tasks. It integrates a memory browser, skills manager, and a full workspace file browser equipped with a Monaco editor and PTY terminal.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: Codeg is a collaborative multi-agent workspace that aggregates sessions from Hermes and other agents into a desktop or self-hosted environment. It supports custom ACP-compatible agent registration and provides native iOS and Android clients for mobile access.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: Designed as a native Mac workspace, this tool provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts for managing real session data. It includes native views for Kanban boards and cron jobs, alongside an embedded terminal for direct shell access and system repair.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: Built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust, this Windows-first desktop application includes the Hermes-CN-Core kernel for local agent execution. The interface supports MCP tools, memory management, and specialized rendering for LaTeX and Mermaid diagrams.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension connects a local or remote Hermes Agent runtime directly to the active browser context. It features site-aware drafting in 31 writing environments and live browser control with explicit approval gates for all actions.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: Hermex is a native SwiftUI iPhone application that allows users to drive a self-hosted Hermes Agent from their mobile device by pairing with a hermes-webui server. It enables real-time chat, task management, and server file system browsing without subscriptions or third-party relays.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: This desktop workspace offers one-click setup for Hermes Agent and other engines, featuring custom LLM model routing. It includes a runtime dashboard for tracking latency and token usage, as well as a live workspace for monitoring code writes and diffs.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-hud: This terminal-based monitor features an interactive TUI with nine tabs and four selectable color themes for tracking agent growth and scheduled cron jobs. It includes a specialized tmux operator view designed for managing live agent panes and git projects.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: A self-hosted web dashboard that provides a browser-based terminal, file explorer, and an MCP server control plane for managing server lifecycles. It features a ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health and kanban pipelines alongside real-time chat and tool call visualization.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: This native macOS session browser functions as a local cockpit that attributes live quota burn to individual sessions for Codex and Claude. It supports searchable transcripts and image browsing for over 14 agent formats without uploading telemetry or session history.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS workspace facilitates one-click automated Hermes Agent installations on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It integrates a WebRTC voice mode utilizing OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP for remote agent interaction.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Built with Next.js 16 and React 19, this dashboard template uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web-based mission control. It includes a dedicated approval inbox for managing agent requests that have side effects.
entries.liftaris/herm: Constructed with OpenTUI, this alternative interface provides a TUI for chatting and managing Hermes Agent sessions. It incorporates a kanban board for task management and supports the configuration of profiles, skills, and toolsets.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: This React-based Telegram Mini App provides a 10-page mobile-first UI with terminal chat and file attachment support. It uses dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication to manage background agent spawning for up to five concurrent instances.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: A portable Windows desktop application that runs without admin rights or system-wide dependencies to provide a Tkinter GUI for local models. It features 100 tools covering music, TTS, and ComfyUI, supported by granular permission controls and session management.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: This glassmorphic web interface enables real-time log streaming and chat for self-hosted AI assistants. It includes an integrated file browser, a task tracking dashboard, and management tools for skills and MCP servers.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: This dashboard provides real-time monitoring of session activity and cost tracking for Hermes deployments. It allows for the full inspection of conversation histories and skill source code, alongside read-only monitoring of environment variables.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A chat-first workspace featuring real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards for interactive agent control. It includes an integrated marketplace for skills and MCP servers, plus isolated profile management for separate sessions and API keys.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This native desktop client orchestrates collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents through a central PM orchestrator. It features a visual Skill Store with over 50 one-click installations and supports streaming SSE responses with model switching.
